items.issues: Hidden notices + lightly mentioned bicycle sale must be combined; B tempts with surface resentment reading. Solid medium.
Budi weaving a strand in confirms B; C (danger) is the only mildly tempting distractor, A/D weak.
'Courteous and final' nearly glosses the answer; B is a literal-reading trap, A/D over-infer. Medium-easy.
Passage states 'calming everything and leaving nothing behind' right after the simile; A/C contradict text outright, only B is plausible.
Requires linking 'nothing she must answer' to 'drink alone'; B is a reasonable misread of 'country'. Good medium.
'Before anyone knew the drains would fail' signals B strongly; C is a direct inversion, A/D plausible but not text-supported. Medium-easy.
'His refusal... had worn thin' makes C near-literal; B and D are literal-sleeve traps that nothing in text supports. Only A is a real distractor.
B/C/D each misread one half of the shift; the ending (sitting down, grape baskets, smiling) clearly supports A.
Clean shift; D is the best distractor (Esteban's gravity), A's 'playful' start is unsupported. Medium-easy.
'Warm gratitude' slightly overstates: text shows softened warmth/laughter rather than explicit gratitude, but no other choice competes.
B invents an inheritance dispute, A/C misdescribe the ending; D is clearly supported by the fried-dough reversal. Medium-easy.
Three-part structure requires noticing the re-measuring as changed planning; B/D import conflict not in text, C is a list trap.
Must weigh past resentment against present habit ('I still plane a board...'); A is the past-only trap, D plays on the mentor-praise aside. Good medium.
'I can smile at that woman now' plus 'she called it loyalty' supports both halves of C; B is the in-the-moment attitude trap.
'How much she had rested on one small claim' paraphrases D directly; A and B are weak, C unrelated. Easy.
A ('resigned acceptance') is partly defensible since he thanks her and keeps working; the pointed question and hidden face tip it to B, but the A/B boundary is finer than ideal.
